connector.name: Post Assembly
connector.registryDescription: Editorial tools for LinkedIn. Capture ideas, draft posts, build narrative arcs, manage a schedule.
connector.summary: Hosted at app.postassembly.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.postassembly, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Post Assembly API key. Sign up at postassembly.com, then generate a key at Settings > API Keys.
